verdict.rationale: Autumn documents an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to its billing, customer, plan, balance, and log tools. A user can therefore drive billing actions, plan management, and request-log investigations in natural language, but only through an external AI assistant, not a native natural-language interface. missing for 10: built-in natural-language command interface in the dashboard or CLI, hands-on or independent corroboration of how well the MCP tools handle conversational operation, details on which operations the MCP exposes.
